artworks.title: Frontispiece for "The Light of the Cloister"
artworks.description: The image shows three figures: one kneeling on the right holding lilies, one in the center kneeling and holding a cross, and one standing on the left with hands on the chest. Above them is a celestial figure amidst clouds with rays shining down. Two winged cherubs hold a cloth in the background. The words "LVX CLAUSTRI" are displayed between the central and celestial figures, with inscriptions around the border.

artworks.title: The Vigilant Eye
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape with latticework fences enclosing sheep grazing. The background shows rolling hills, trees, and a tall post. The style resembles engraving or etching with detailed cross-hatching for shading. The monochromatic palette creates contrast for depth.

artworks.title: Candle Stick
artworks.description: The image displays a tall, narrow candlestick on an ornate base in the center of a room. The color palette is a monochrome sepia. There is a geometric-patterned ceiling above, with intersecting lines indicating the walls and floor leading to a doorway in the back. On the right side, another room is visible with a bench and a window framing a landscape outside.

artworks.title: Shepherds Defending their Herds
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with sheep in the foreground. Two figures are seen wielding staffs in motion to the left, while another figure appears to be interacting with a reclining animal to the right. In the background, there are rolling hills, vegetation, and a tower. The style is reminiscent of etching or engraving, with fine line work and a monochrome color palette emphasizing form over color.

artworks.title: The Crow and her Young
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a detailed tree on the left, birds flying, a figure to the right, and hills and buildings in the distance. The style features precise line work in black ink on a cream background.

artworks.title: The Tulips and the Sun
artworks.description: The image features intricate line work and shading. The central focus is a formation of rocks. In the background, there is a visible horizon and a sun emitting rays. Flowers are depicted on both sides of the formation. The sky above includes small star-like figures and radiant lines. The color palette is monochrome, utilizing shades of black and off-white.

artworks.title: Burning Phoenix
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a slightly elevated point of view. In the top third of the image lies the horizon, with small hills, shrubs, and distant trees scattered across it. In the center of the image, on a hill nearby, is a detailed depiction of a bird with outstretched wings. The landscape is rendered in a linear style with fine, precise lines creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and cream to define forms and contours, emphasizing the details of the bird and the surrounding terrain.

artworks.title: Crow and Snail
artworks.description: This image shows a bird flying down towards a snail on a textured surface. The snail has a spiral shell and is moving across the surface. In the background, there are trees, a house-like structure, and hills. The artwork is characterized by fine linework and hatching, creating texture and shading. The color palette is monochrome with shades of beige and brown.

artworks.title: Serpent
artworks.description: This image features a rocky landscape with large, jagged rocks forming a natural barrier. In the middle of the scene, a detailed snake is coiled on the ground. The rocks dominate the composition, rising towards the background. The artwork is monochromatic, primarily in shades of brown and grey, with deliberate brushstrokes and etched lines creating texture.

artworks.title: Cat Watching Caged Bird
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a cat in the foreground. In the distance, there is a hilly horizon with small structures and trees. Foliage and birds are subtly depicted in the distance. The style consists of precise lines and cross-hatching for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochrome with aged paper providing a yellowish tone. The inked lines are deep, creating contrast.

artworks.title: Two Knights
artworks.description: The scene is shown from a slightly elevated perspective, with riders and an undulating landscape visible. The horizon line is positioned about a third of the way down from the top, featuring small buildings and trees. The illustration employs fine lines and hatching for texture and depth, resembling engraving. The color scheme is primarily brown and beige, evoking early printed works. One rider on a galloping horse raises their arm, while another rider with a lance is on a more stationary horse. In the background, there are rolling hills and vegetation.

artworks.title: Stag in the Water
artworks.description: The image shows a stag standing in water, with a town in the distance. The stag has large antlers, and the background includes hills, a sky with birds, a tree with bare branches, and a rock near the water. The artwork uses fine, precise brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette of blacks, grays, and cream.

artworks.title: Bird Perched in a Thistle
artworks.description: The image features a low angle view showing plants in the foreground and a landscape with hills and small built structures in the background. The artwork is detailed with etching lines, depicting a small bird on a stem. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black, tan, and off-white tones to highlight the etched lines and shapes.

artworks.title: Nightingale in a Bush
artworks.description: The image shows a solitary tree with a bird perched on its branches. In the background, there are distant hills, a small building, and some trees. The drawing style uses fine lines to depict the tree and bird, with a monochrome color palette of black, gray, and cream. The sky includes faintly sketched clouds.

artworks.title: Eagle Losing an Old Feather
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape viewed from above. Various hills and structures create a rural or small town setting. An eagle flies in the center of the image, with expressive brushstrokes and streaks of light filling the sky. A village on a hill is depicted on the right side. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black lines. The composition balances open space with detailed elements, guiding the eye through the scene.

artworks.title: Crane Flying
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with large round rocks at the center. Two birds are perched on the rocks and another bird is flying above them holding an item. In the background, there is a horizon line with hints of water meeting the sky and a distant sailboat. On the left side, a small tower-like structure is visible. The etching features sharp brushstrokes to depict textures of the landscape and birds. The color palette is monochromatic using black and beige. The scene conveys a serene moment with a flying bird suggesting movement.

artworks.title: Siren between Two Ships
artworks.description: The image displays a seascape portrayed in a linear style with careful brushstrokes. The horizon is central, separating the sea and sky. Two ships with sails and flags are visible on the horizon. In the center, a figure resembling a mermaid plays a horn in the water. Rocks frame the scene on the right. The color scheme is monochrome with cream paper and dark ink.

artworks.title: Crayfish Looking at the Sun
artworks.description: A lobster is in the foreground on a sandy patch of land. The scene is monochromatic, with various shades of beige and dark brown lines. To the right of the lobster, a cluster of grass sprouts from the sand. Behind the lobster, the calm sea stretches horizontally with a small sun visible near the horizon.

artworks.title: Sun Rising
artworks.description: The image features a coastal area with a body of water below. The horizon line splits the sky from the land and water. There are medieval-style fortified structures on the horizon with towers and buildings. The artwork appears to be done in an etching technique with fine, linear brushstrokes to depict detail. The sky shows clouds, sunbeams, and a radiant sun. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of black on a light tan or cream background.

artworks.title: The Tomb
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape with a large sarcophagus and a skeleton inside. The drawing includes a scene with a grand, ornately decorated sarcophagus on the right side. The sarcophagus is open, revealing a skeleton. On the left side, two draped figures stand observing. In the background, there are hills and a castle or fortress. The sky has a few clouds and is drawn in a linear style.

artworks.title: Nun Embracing the Holy Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an individual standing with a large wooden cross in a sparse landscape. The drawing depicts an individual in robes and a halo, holding a tall wooden cross with an inscription. The landscape shows a few structures in the distance, including towers and what appears to be domed architecture. The drawing utilizes fine pen lines to define shapes and create a sense of depth, with minimal shading.

artworks.title: Narcissus Looking in the Water
artworks.description: The image portrays a figure kneeling near a body of water surrounded by a landscape. The scene shows the figure leaning over the water, with a reflection visible. In the background, there are hills meeting the sky and sparse foliage on trees. A tree with twisting branches is on the right side. The style features intricate lines suggesting detailed etching. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brownish-black on an off-white background. Small structures can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Willows by the Water's Edge
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a row of trees along the horizon. The trees are depicted with thin, intricate lines, suggesting movement. There is a body of water reflecting the trees. The artwork has fine linework and a monochrome color palette, with minimal detail in the sky.

artworks.title: Two Hearts
artworks.description: The image features two rectangular pedestals in the foreground. The left pedestal displays a heart with flames, while the right pedestal shows intertwined snakes. The color palette is primarily beige with black outlines, resembling an aged illustration style. In the background, there is a building between the pedestals, with faint landscape sketches on the sides.
